title: The Chain of Origins: Every Good Traced to Its Divine Source
arc: The teaching is a hymnic catalogue that names, in descending order of emanation, the specific divine source from which each class of good and each operation of redemption proceeds — beginning at the Father of Lights and ending at the Mind of Light who awakens sleepers and raises them eight-fold into eternal life.
reading:
This chapter is built as a litany of "ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ" — "the Origin of…" — statements. Each statement takes a class of good things (gifts, blessings, counsels, honors, warriors, builders, releasers, wisdoms, awakenings) and traces it back to the specific divine entity from which that class proceeds. Read correspondentially, the whole teaching is a single argument: every good in the cosmos and every operation of regeneration has its source in the Lord, and the Lord stands behind each kind of good under a distinct register of his love and wisdom. Nothing in the regenerate process originates in the human; everything proceeds from divine source through ordered emanations.

The chain begins at the inmost. The "beautiful gifts" are first attributed to the Great Father of the Lights — the Father of Greatness, the Divine Esse from which all influx flows. From him "by his hand" all things are given. The next origin named is the source of "every blessing and all prayers": the Mother of Life, foremost of the Holy Spirit — Divine Wisdom in her bringing-forth, the matrix through which divine good is generated as truth that can be received and answered. Together these two name the inmost polarity from which the whole cascade proceeds.

The litany then moves through the operative emanations. Counsels are referred to the King of Glory set in the firmament of the King of the Lights — Divine Truth in its judicial governance over the discrete degrees. Honor is referred to the Beloved of the Lights — Divine Love in its emanating aspect, the principle by which all love returns home. Warriors and hunters — the active forces of redemption that go out against self-love — are referred to the First Man, named here as the living one, the Father of Life who has poured out his five sons in every place. This is the descent of Divine Truth into the natural in its complete five-fold structure, the Living Soul scattered through the cosmos as the basis of redemption. Architects and builders are referred to the Great Builder, Divine Wisdom in its shaping power that orders the new aeon. The bearing-up of the cosmos is referred to the unique upholder of all the Omophoroi — the patience of Divine Wisdom carrying the burden of the natural.

The litany then turns specifically to the redemptive operations. The "Origin of all the Releasers" is named, glossed as "the one who looses to raise those who are bound by his words" — the Lord in his releasing-and-raising operation, the Call that unbinds captive light. The Origin of all the Wisdoms of the Truth is the Virgin of Light — purity of reception, Divine Wisdom in her uncorrupted form, the source from which all true wisdoms in the cosmos derive their authenticity.

The catalogue culminates in the Mind of Light, and here the teaching expands beyond the formula. The Mind of Light is named as the awakener of sleepers, the gatherer-to-recognition of those scattered forth — the illumined rational understanding through which the Lord rouses the soul from spiritual sleep and conjoins what self-love had dispersed. The text traces the soul's approach "to the feet" of him in whom the eye is not blinded — the foot signifying the ultimate plane where the soul makes contact, the unblinded eye signifying the perfected understanding that does not fail. He is established firm in all the lights and all the lives, with all souls under his hand. Coming to his feet, the souls are opened "eight-fold out from their grip" — eight as the new state beyond the seven of completion, the resurrection-state that releases the soul from the binding of self-love — so that they may inherit life forever and ever.

The arc, then, runs from the inmost Father, down through the maternal bringing-forth, through the governing and loving emanations, through the descent of the First Man and his five sons into the natural, through the building and bearing-up of the cosmos, through the releasing Call, through uncorrupted Wisdom, and out into the Mind of Light who actually awakens, gathers, raises, and brings the soul into its eighth-day inheritance. Read as one teaching, it is a complete map of the order of emanation: the Lord's redemption is not a single act but a sequence of distinct divine operations, each with its own register, and the regenerate soul moves homeward by being lifted through the entire chain back to its source.
